objective: Compare scoped developer-memory profiles on correct patches, escaped regressions and complete acquisition/use cost; not universal product superiority.
principles: Same model and repository inputs per task
Same historical episodes, source provenance and current context
Same candidate generator, current-test executor and model-call/character budgets
Historical source fetch available to all profiles for provenance IDs actually retrieved
No commits or pushes; ShadowFrog memory profile excludes Dream publication workflow
Preserve all runs, labels, errors and setup limits
No-memory abstention is scored separately from wrong patches
Full-history and raw artifact storage are competent positive controls

corpus.gold: Frozen reference compatibility behavior plus explicit task extension, separate current/hidden checks
corpus.nature: Synthetic repositories; no OSS productivity claim

acceptance: Report wins/ties/losses per profile, not a blended invented maturity score
A claim of better results must name the workload/profile and show held-out accuracy/regression or parity with lower measured total cost
If raw controls tie or beat Synopsis, report this and investigate whether extra machinery is justified
Do not attribute end-to-end workflow effects solely to retrieval or claim Dream was run
